_comment: {C}-NECESSITY test. Board = 8 Mountains + 1 Unclaimed Territory = 9 sources. Dragonstorm {8}{R} = 9 mana. It is payable ONLY if Unclaimed contributes its {C} to the generic (8 Mountains alone = 8 < 9), AND the {R} pip is taken from a Mountain (not Unclaimed, which can't make red for this non-creature). Dragonstorm tutors Utvara Hellkite (6/6 flying), which kills opp (6 life) next turn. PASS(win T5) => {C} counted + ordering OK. FAIL(no win) => {C} not counted (the bug hypothesis).
